crossRefs.note: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.
Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,
For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow…
Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.
Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul;
then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
When you pass through the waters, I will be with you, and through the rivers, they will not overflow you. When you walk…
Waters flowed over my head. I said, “I am cut off.”
He said to me, “The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

parallels.note: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

translations.web: He sent from on high and he took me. He drew me out of many waters.
translations.bsb: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
translations.kjv: He sent from above, he took me; he drew me out of many waters;
translations.asv: He sent from on high, he took me; He drew me out of many waters;
